rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for achieving an intended goal or having an effort turn out successfully.

example.english: This time, the plan did succeed in the end.
example.traditional: 今次個計劃終於成功喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone managed to complete a particular task or achieve something they set out to do.

example.english: I did succeed in handing in the report before the deadline.
example.traditional: 我終於做到喺限期前交份報告喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 zou6 dou3 hai2 haan6 kei4 cin4 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 laa3
